memory_candidates.content: Plan shape for a Lean record whose filed statement is refuted or unstatable and the user has ruled [BLOCKED]: one pre-decided [BLOCKED] Phase 1 quoting the filed goals verbatim (never a prerequisite of any executable phase, so no implementer waits on it), then contingency phases that (a) port a plan-time-compiled prototype into a wired probe under specs/evidence with the collection's header conventions, (b) add one WIRED row/entry to scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh, (c) amend the README/theorem-index with durable anchors only, (d) amend the design-of-record spec and the task description via state-write.sh so no residue of the refuted device survives, and (e) a final full-gate phase that returns partial + requires_user_review: true + blocked_phase: 1, never implemented. The plan-level Status field is left to the postflight. Used by the twelfth and thirteenth seam-gluing-ray-product probes.
